controls.source: The template requires Daze and the landed Dim Mak Strike effect applies Powerless. The shared player control executor carries state and separate immunity records.

controls.test: PR579 records Powerless for 6.12 s and separate immunity for 6 s on QAEnemy, refusal of Cheap Shot while controlled, removal of both records and acceptance after release.
